inicio.encabezado: Foro Internacional de Música Nueva Manuel Enríquez
inicio.entrada: Read the terms of each call, fill in your application at your own pace and submit it once it is complete.
inicio.sin_convocatorias: There are no published calls at the moment.
inicio.paso1_texto: We only ask for an email address, your name and a password. The same account works every year.
inicio.paso2_texto: Your application saves itself as you type. You can pick it up another day or from another device.
inicio.paso3_texto: On submission you will receive a PDF receipt by email with your reference number. After submitting you can no longer edit.
convocatoria.bases_pdf: Download the terms as a PDF
convocatoria.sin_bases: The terms of this call are not available yet.
convocatoria.bases_respaldo: The terms of this call are only available in Spanish.
convocatoria.participa_texto: You need an account to apply. You can work over several sessions before submitting.
convocatoria.proxima_texto: Applications are not open yet. In the meantime you can read the terms and create your account.
convocatoria.cerrada_texto: This call no longer accepts applications. If you applied, sign in to view your application.
cuenta.ingresar_entrada: Enter the email address and password of your account.
cuenta.registro_entrada: Your account will serve for this and future editions. Artistic details are requested later, in the application itself.
cuenta.recuperar_entrada: Enter the email address of your account and we will send you a link to choose a new password. The link is valid for one hour.
cuenta.password_ayuda: At least 10 characters. A long phrase is better than a word with symbols.
cuenta.idioma_ayuda: Emails and your receipt will be sent in this language.
cuenta.acepto_aviso: I have read and accept the
cuenta.sin_verificar: Your email address is not confirmed yet. You can work on your application, but you will not be able to submit it until you confirm it. Look for our message in your inbox, including the spam folder.
cuenta.password_nota: Changing it will sign you out on your other devices.
cuenta.email_nota: The new address will need to be confirmed again. We will notify the previous address of the change.
cuenta.verificar_entrada: Press the button to confirm that this email address is yours.
cuenta.restablecer_entrada: Enter the new password for your account. Saving it will sign you out everywhere.
cuenta.activar_entrada: Choose the password you will use to sign in to the platform.

aviso.pendiente: The official text of the full privacy notice must be provided by the CNMO. This page is a provisional outline and has no legal validity.
aviso.entrada: The platform processes personal data of private individuals in accordance with Mexico's Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP).
aviso.datos_texto: Your account details (email address, name and language) and whatever you enter in your application. CURP, RFC and bank details are not requested.
aviso.finalidad_texto: To receive, review and evaluate your application to the Forum's calls.
aviso.arco_texto: You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, cancellation and objection. The procedure and contact details will be published with the official text.
